tickets.title: Coordinate account access recovery
tickets.text: Use this coordination template when a client cannot access an account portal, custodian login, document vault, or authentication method. Confirm identity requirements, preserve security, and document all handoffs without collecting passwords. For Rowan Cloudpuddle, restore access to the Velvet Acorn Custody portal after a mobile carrier change that prevents retrieval of recent confirmations and statements needed for distribution authorization.

subTasks.title: Confirm access problem and security boundaries
subTasks.text: Ask the client which portal is affected, what error message appears, whether multi-factor authentication changed, and what contact information is on file. Do not request or record passwords, full security answers, or authentication codes.

subTasks.title: Handoff to custodian or platform recovery channel
subTasks.text: Provide the client with the correct custodian or platform recovery path, required identification steps, and support contact method. If advisor involvement is permitted, confirm what authorization is needed before joining a call or submitting a service request.

subTasks.title: Verify restoration and update records
subTasks.text: After the client reports access is restored, confirm whether contact information, trusted contact, delivery preferences, or document access settings changed. Update internal notes and flag any suspicious activity for further review.

tickets.title: Run debt refinance review checklist
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before recommending a refinance:

- Confirm current loan type, balance, interest rate, payment, remaining term, and prepayment penalties.
- Gather proposed refinance rate, term, payment, closing costs, points, and escrow changes.
- Calculate breakeven period using total refinance costs and monthly payment change.
- Compare total interest cost under current loan versus proposed loan if held through the expected time horizon.
- Check whether the refinance extends debt beyond retirement or another planning milestone.
- Review cash flow impact, emergency reserve impact, and debt-to-income considerations.
- Identify tax considerations, including mortgage interest deductibility assumptions where relevant.
- Confirm whether credit score, income documentation, appraisal, or title issues could affect approval.
- Note non-financial reasons for refinancing, such as payment stability, removing a borrower, or consolidating debt.
- Document recommendation, assumptions, and unresolved lender questions. For Rowan Cloudpuddle and Elena Mossbutton, assess the Pocket Lantern Bank home equity line ($38,000 balance, 8.1% variable rate) and the $210,000 mortgage at 3.25% fixed, to determine whether paying down the line, refinancing, or leaving in place best aligns with cash reserve target and retirement income plan.
tickets.evidence: For the home equity line and mortgage review, the review surfaced an 8.1% variable-rate home equity balance alongside a lower fixed mortgage rate.
